skill.summary: Incident response process management following the NIST 800-61 lifecycle. Covers severity classification, escalation matrices, role assignment, communication...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the incident-response-lifecycle skill for structured incident management based on the NIST 800-61 framework.

- Provides end-to-end incident process management: detection, classification, escalation, coordination, communication, recovery, and post-incident review.
- Covers severity assignment (P1–P4), role allocation (Incident Commander, Technical Lead, Communications Lead, Scribe), and escalation matrices.
- Includes templates and guidance for stakeholder communications, post-mortems, and root cause analysis (5-whys, fishbone).
- Focuses on process and coordination; excludes technical forensics and evidence gathering, which are handled by the incident-response-network skill.
- Outlines prerequisites for effective incident management, including authority, contact directories, and communication channels.
